top_signals.title: Dangote Refinery Offers East Africa Almost 20% of IPO Shares
top_signals.summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery & Petrochemicals FZE, which owns Africa’s biggest crude-processing facility in Nigeria, is offering investors based in the continent’s east an almost 20% share its initial public offering that could raise as much as $300.4 million.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
